items.text: We've been busy behind the scenes at Denki HQ and we're back with another round of fixes and improvements for Sniper Dan! 🎯

Thanks to your continued feedback, we've been able to identify a few things that could use a little extra attention, from making certain jobs easier to understand to improving mini-games, tutorials and general gameplay.
PC Patch #2 is now LIVE on Steam!
Here's everything that's been updated.
We've made several changes to help make your adventures around Clumsy County a little smoother!
💡 Helpful Hints & Tutorials
🛒 Buying Hints at the Magic Market
Some players weren't aware they could purchase additional hints.
We've added a new tutorial that appears when you first enter the Magic Market, explaining how to purchase more hints when you need a helping hand.
Some Sniperintendents didn't realise they could fire rapidly during Bonus Rounds.
We've updated the on-screen messaging to make this clearer with the new text:
"Rapid Fire Activated"
Controller players now receive an additional tutorial when entering a level for the first time after purchasing the camera.
This explains how to use the right analogue stick for finer zoom control.
Bowling can be a little tricky when you're trying to line up that perfect shot!
We've added helpful tips to all three mini-games, which appear after players complete each mini-game for the first time and view the results screen.
A few jobs around Clumsy County have received some extra attention to make their objectives and interactions clearer.
We've removed the word "Yar!" from the job description after discovering that some players thought they were looking for a pirate.
A small change to help point you in the right direction!
The fishing rod's interactive area has been expanded.
Players can now hover over a larger section of the rod to trigger the red reveal circle, rather than needing to find the handle.
We've replaced the fisherman with a pirate to better match the job description and make the objective clearer.
Some players were attempting to shoot luggage before it passed through the detectors.
We've added semi-transparent covers to the conveyor belts to prevent bags from being shot too early and help clarify the intended gameplay.
Tennis balls now become darker after being shot, making it easier to identify which balls are still in play.
We've also squashed a collection of bugs reported by the community!
Day 1 – Solve Mystery: Fixed an issue where shooting the blue paint spot on the door wouldn't open it.
Day 3 – Spilt Oil: Adjusted the job's reveal area. Players must now hover over the hangar doors rather than the surrounding hangar area.
Day 3 – Boss: Fixed an issue where animals could occasionally pass through closed gates.
Fixed an issue where items collected for Tiny Tim's Answerphone missions could occasionally fall onto the office floor.
Air Hockey: Fixed an issue where shooting Mrs Mop immediately after starting could incorrectly trigger a "Max Score" and "Victory" result.
Bonus Games: Fixed an issue where switching between locations on the map wouldn't update the displayed high score.
Bowling: Fixed an issue where Handy Hank's hat could remain on the ground after switching mini-games. Hats can no longer be shot off during mini-games.
Steam Overlay: Fixed an issue where the game could become unresponsive when pausing a mini-game and opening the Steam Overlay.
Bowling: Fixed an issue where the dotted aiming line could remain visible after quitting via ESC > Quit.
A massive THANK YOU to everyone who's taken the time to report bugs, share suggestions and tell us about their experiences with Sniper Dan.
Your feedback continues to help us make Clumsy County an even better place to explore, one shot at a time!
If you encounter anything unusual or have suggestions for improvements, please keep letting us know.

items.text: Patch #1 is now live on Steam! 🎯

It's been a full week since launch and we’ve been continuing to read your all of your feedback and reports and it's been really cool to gauge where we can improve your experience with Sniper Dan. This latest update includes more fixes alongside several gameplay improvements based directly on what you’ve been telling us.
(Version Number: V43)
🔧 Fixes
Jiangshi Achievement 🧟
Fixed an issue where the Jiangshi achievement would not appear on the fridge after being unlocked.
Remove Posters Job
Fixed an issue where the Remove Posters job could visually overlap with the Clean Dishes job making it too difficult to find.
Rifle & Camera Controls 📸
Your viewing direction will no longer reset when switching between Rifle and Camera modes.
This change is based on feedback from players who found they could lose track of their target when switching between the two...good spot!
Central City Day 2 Emergency 🏙️
We’ve increased the amount of time available during the Day 2 Emergency to give you more time to work out what needs to be done.
Aces Airport Day 2 Emergency ✈️
We’ve also increased the amount of time available during the Day 2 Emergency following similar player feedback.
Answerphone Tutorial ☎️
The tutorial pointing hand will now direct you towards the open door after activating the Answerphone making it clearer where you need to go next.
Funky Farm Boss 🚜
We’ve made the Funky Farm Boss easier and more accurate following feedback from players who found this section frustrating at times.
Aces Airport Boss ✈️
The number of lives available during the Aces Airport Boss has been increased from 3 to 5 giving you more time to work out what you need to do.
Several of the changes in Patch #1 have come directly from your feedback and we’ll continue listening as we work with Denki to improve your time in Clumsy County.
Keep the feedback coming and thanks for playing, Sniperintendents! 🎯
